fuente.titulo: Pope Leo prays for end to humanitarian crisis in Somalia

titular: Pope Leo XIV prays for peace in Somalia
bajada: He calls for an end to violence and more aid for the humanitarian crisis
caption: Pope Leo XIV offered prayers for an end to violence in parts of Somalia and appealed for greater assistance amid the ongoing humanitarian crisis. Source: Vatican News, Sept 20, 2026.

ilustracion.descripcion: A quiet map-like view of the Horn of Africa coastline at dusk, with a small humanitarian aid tent in the upper right third; left and center areas open and empty, no text or logos.
